Commission imposes provisional import quotas on hybrid passenger vehicles
The European Commission today published provisional safeguard measures setting import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles. These restrictions are needed to protect EU industry against a sharp recent increase in imports of such vehicles. The measures will enter into force on 1 December and follow an investigation that showed imports of hybrid vehicles into the EU have increased significantly since 2023.

Commission proposes stronger recognition of European heritage sites
The European Commission has proposed to renew and reinforce the legal framework of the European Heritage Label. The scheme was adopted in 2011 aiming to offer a recognition awarded by the European Union to sites - buildings, monuments, documents - of exceptional symbolic value that have played a key role in shaping Europe's history, culture, and integration.

Le mécanisme de protection civile de l'UE fête ses 25 ans

EU sets out a new Strategy for the Arctic
Today, the European Commission and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy presented a new Strategy for the Arctic. The Strategy presents a new framework of political cooperation for like-minded partners that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core. It has four priorities: strengthening security and resilience, responding to climate change in the Arctic, prosperity, and opportunities for people and communities in the Arctic.
